story: Make Show in Transcript work for a document opened from a subagent's conversation, which is not a tab the window can find.
defect: DocumentViewController now holds (strongly) the TranscriptViewController it was opened from — a sibling tab in the editor area, handed over by TranscriptViewController.open via TranscriptTab.makeDocumentItem — and calls its reveal(_:select:) directly, bypassing the coordinator (TranscriptTabDelegate) and coupling the document shell to the root transcript type.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Component boundaries — B4: a component names only what it builds or holds, never a sibling's type; events go up through the delegate (and the Transcript CLAUDE.md: Documents/ never names the root)
hit: Says DocumentViewController references/holds a TranscriptViewController (its sibling / the tab it came from) and calls reveal on it directly instead of reporting Show in Transcript up to the coordinator; strong cross-tab reference.
